facts.value: The International Office of Economics is the central contact point for all students of the department with questions regarding international topics. It especially advises students on the organization of a study abroad and supervises guests from foreign partner universities during their studies in Frankfurt.

facts.value: Here, international students are facilitated by a Frankfurt buddy to ease their entry into Goethe University and Frankfurt. Experienced students of the university provide support for orientation on campus, in studies, and in Frankfurt while having the opportunity for intercultural and linguistic exchange.
